import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the MSD data
msd_data = pd.read_csv('msd_data.csv')

# Calculate the time in seconds (assuming timestep of 0.001 ps)
time = msd_data['Step'] * 0.001 * 1e-12  # Convert to seconds

# Calculate the mean squared displacement
msd = msd_data['Density']  # Assuming 'Density' column contains MSD data

# Perform linear regression to find the slope
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(time, msd, 1)

# Calculate the diffusion coefficient
D = slope / 6

# Print the diffusion coefficient
print(f'{D:.5e}')
